label: Data Machine · CPU
goodFor: Large-memory CPU analysis and substantial local I/O using 32 TB of node-local NVMe storage.
limitations: No compute GPU. Local data must be staged and saved deliberately; it is not permanent shared storage. Data Machine account access is required.
note: Data Machine page rounds RAM to 2 TB; the cluster table lists 2005 GB available to jobs. The published 256 scheduler CPUs are not 256 physical cores.
